test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All carpets are scholars.

All scholars are trip advisors.

No hat is a trip advisor.

Conclusions:

I. No trip advisor is a scholar.

II. All carpets are trip advisors.

III. Some trip advisors are scholars. ​

IV. No carpet is a hat.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only conclusions II, III and IV follow.

solution:
__Statements__:**
All carpets are scholars.

All scholars are trip advisors.

No hat is a trip advisor.

**__Venn diagram__:**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b22cec76d6efbd1a8d3660f1de282d8e2b20a7254b070b88e4dc7fd15b0d48f.png] 

__Conclusions__:

I. No trip advisor is a scholar → Does not follow → We have 'all scholars are trip advisors' which means there has to be some trip advisors that are scholars and thus the conclusion does not follow.

II. All carpets are trip advisors → Follow →Because 'all carpets are scholars' and 'all scholars are trip advisors' imply 'all carpets are trip advisors' and the same can be seen in the Venn diagram.

III. Some trip advisors are scholars → Follow → We have 'all scholars are trip advisors' which means there have to be some trip advisors that are scholars and thus the conclusion follows.

IV. No carpet is a hat → Follow → Since 'all carpets are trip advisors' and 'no hat is a trip advisor' then it is not possible that a carpet is a hat therefore the conclusion follows.

So, **only conclusions II, III, and IV follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is " Only conclusions II, III, IV follow ".**
